test_goal: Build a bench-mounted robotic arm that can pick one printed enclosure part from a tray and align it over a case for later human-confirmed assembly; manufacture arm links/brackets using HS CAD tools, and integrate checked motors/controllers when specimens exist.
manual_gate: all dimensions/ratings must be replaced by measured or model/revision-verified evidence before physical energization
design_assumptions_not_evidence: Assumed motors stand for classes of geared actuators with encoders, not identified donor motors or purchase recommendations.
The 24 V supply is a hypothesis only; no real power source, driver, controller or current rating is verified.
The arm payload includes a provisional lid or other printed part; existing 74.10g slicer estimate covers both case parts and does not establish measured lid mass.
Link mass and rigidity estimates are independent benchmark intervals; selected printable material and orientation remain unverified.
URDF collision objects are simple proxy boxes, not a tested robot or exact fabricated joints.
